gloss: overall picture; big picture; full scope

definitions.gloss: overall picture; big picture; full scope
definitions.explanation: The complete view or comprehensive understanding of something, including all its parts and aspects.

examples.japanese: {全体像|ぜんたいぞう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つかむ。
⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{全体像|ぜんたいぞう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}します→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
examples.english: First, I will explain the overall picture of the plan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧とらわれず、{全体像|ぜんたいぞう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧だ。
examples.english: It is important to look at the big picture without getting caught up in the details.

notes:
{全体像|ぜんたいぞう} means the overall or complete picture of something. It is used when stepping back from details to understand how all the parts fit together.

FORMS:
⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧ (whole, entirety) + ⟦{像|ぞう}→像：03691_zou⟧ (image, picture). The ⟦{像|ぞう}→像：03691_zou⟧ suffix appears in similar abstract nouns like {将来像|しょうらいぞう} (vision of the future) and ⟦{人物像|じんぶつぞう}→人物像：26017_jinbutsuzou⟧ (character portrait).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全体像|ぜんたいぞう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つかむ: to grasp the big picture
- {全体像|ぜんたいぞう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{把握|はあく}する→把握する：19628_haakusuru⟧: to comprehend the full scope
- {全体像|ぜんたいぞう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧: to show the overall picture
- {全体像|ぜんたいぞう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧: the full picture becomes clear

USAGE:
Common in business presentations, project planning, and academic contexts. Often contrasted with ⟦{細部|さいぶ}→細部：20562_saibu⟧ (details) or ⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧ (parts).
